content: Yes, 7 is a prime number. A prime number is defined as a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself. To determine if 7 is prime, we check for divisibility by all integers from 2 up to the square root of 7 (approximately 2.645). The only relevant prime in this range is 2. Since 7 ÷ 2 = 3.5 (not a whole number), 7 has no divisors other than 1 and itself. Therefore, **7 is a prime number**.
